title: BMI Study for Children Ages 6-9 Years and Parents
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to test the Fitwits office tool and games with 6-9 year old children and their parents to: 1) assist parent-child dyad with correct BMI status identification and understanding; 2) address nutrition, portion size, and activity cues; and, 3) track BMI trajectory over 12-month period.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ages 6-9 regardless of BMI status

Exclusion Criteria:

* non-English-speaking
